description: Ministry of Defence - Promoted Air Marshal Gagan Pulasthi Bulathsinhala to the Rank of Air Chief Marshal w.e.f. 11.09.2016 and approved his retirement from the appointment of the Head of the Sri Lanka Air Force w.e.f. 12.09.2016 - Promoted the Air Vice Marshal Kapila Veediya Bandara Jayampathy to the Rank of Air Marshal and appointed him as the Head of the Sri Lanka Air Force w.e.f. 12.09.2016
reasoning: The gazette content exclusively concerns government personnel changes (promotion and retirement of named military officers - Air Marshal Gagan Pulasthi Bulathsinghala and Air Vice Marshal Kapila Veediya Bandara Jayampathi). It provides only basic titles/ranks ("Air Chief Marshal," "Head of the Sri Lanka Air Force") without any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities, subject areas, or duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2) as it contains only personnel announcements with named individuals and their general titles.
